content:
iPhone 18 Pro will be unveiled next week, and a credible Weibo tipster has posted a new update listing three new colours expected to debut.

iPhone 18 Pro is likely to come in three brand new colours, with none carried over from last year

At next week's September event, Apple will reveal all the details of its new flagship iPhone lineup.

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will arrive alongside the iPhone Ultra, and the market rumour mill has revealed plenty of expectations.

Colour often seems to be one of the final details Apple locks in. This year, however, the broad consensus is that the flagship will replace Cosmic Orange with a deep cherry/burgundy red, and add brand new silver and sky blue options.

There has been ongoing debate in the market about whether Apple will offer a black/space grey option this year.

However, the latest post from Weibo tipster "Fixed Focus Digital" points to a slightly different colour lineup. He predicts:

  • Deep cherry/burgundy red
  • Sky blue
  • Black

The tipster says the silver version is "almost certainly" not coming, and adds in a follow-up post that he has seen no evidence of its existence. If this lineup holds true, it means Apple will replace the entire colour range of the iPhone 17 Pro with all-new models for the iPhone 18 Pro.

Sky blue has previously been used on the iPhone Air and MacBook Air, and the blue on both is very subtle, looking more like silver in everyday light. So Apple may be hoping sky blue can be the ideal alternative for users who prefer silver.

Many users were disappointed last year that the iPhone 17 Pro did not come in a black or space grey option. So hopes are high that this latest leak is true, bringing black back to the iPhone 18 Pro.

Among these options, which iPhone 18 Pro new colour would you buy? Let us know in the comments.
